steps.name: Ela
steps.text: We've arrived at Magnethill No. 2. Repeat, we've arrived at Magnethill No. 2.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Doc, how are things over on your side?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Exterior clear.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Considering the unique properties of Magnethill No. 2, I suggest we meet up.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Agreed.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Drone recon report, Iana.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Almost no different from the way we left it. Readings are virtually the same, and there is no sign of activity from any other party.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Looks like the quarantine on Magnethill No. 2 has been pretty well enforced.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Which is to say, there's nobody here.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: And that's not good news, because we're here to look for the missing Ash squad.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Keep your eyes open. We'll proceed to Levi's main lab once we rendezvous.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Here we are.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: This is where Levi's main lab was, according to the map.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: We were only one step behind Cohen. There were tremors, then...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I don't know if it was that madman Levi, or something wrong with the equipment, but the whole lab disappeared into thin air.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Into thin air? Are you sure?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I'd say that in my expert opinion, it's the most fitting description of the events.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: That just doesn't seem possible.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: No explosion can wipe out all evidence that a lab ever existed. It wouldn't have left a big hole like this, sending only a few tremors through those outside.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Earthquake? Or is it like you said...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: It's not an earthquake!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: The tremors might well be linked to the disappearance.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Find cover and wait for the tremors to pass!

steps.name: Grumbling Soldier
steps.text: How many floors are there? My legs are starting to scream.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Keep going up, we need to reach the Reynell's penthouse.

steps.name: Grumbling Soldier
steps.text: Can't we take the elevator? Why do we have to climb these stairs floor by floor?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: You think I don't want to?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Recon report on the security here indicates that the penthouse is only accessible by these stairs and his own private elevator.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: There are guards posted by the elevator on every floor.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Security is weakest on the stairs, that's where we break through.

steps.name: Grumbling Soldier
steps.text: Guy's just a Kazimierzian who came to make some money, isn't he? It's not like he has anybody backing him up. Why do we have to be so careful just to get him to sign a transfer agreement?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: He has money. That's all the backing he needs.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Keep moving. Quit looking around!

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: I'm completely spent, boss... I'd rather take the lift and fight my way through.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Shh...

steps.name: Tired Soldier
steps.text: Captain?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: (Whisper) We've almost reached the office! Quiet down..

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: A letter? I told you, you can open those on your own. No need to ask me.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: It says for your eyes only, Reynell.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Where is it from?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Kazimierz... looks like it's from your uncle.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Ah, the usual inheritance demand.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Also... one from the Dossoles municipal government.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: A letter from the city? Probably nothing important. Should be another stupid banquet invitation.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Maybe Candela will be there. We could discuss the opening ceremony with her. It's not far off, after all, and you've spent so much time and effort on it...

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: It's probably going to be spectacular.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Come, stand with me, Miłosz.
The man walks up and stands by the red-haired Vulpo's side.
They admire the artwork at the end of the room, about the height of two persons.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I'm naming it 'The Fall of Order'. What do you think?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Er... sure. You want to show it at the opening?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: We've always been straight with each other, haven't we?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Is that twisted curve intended to represent the 'fall'?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: No, it represents the fleeting gaze of society on man.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: A dogmatic gaze that considers all that does not conform to be madness. Lines that can only emerge from a post-Profound Silence Iberia.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: The Iberian Inquisition. Certainly a symbol of order.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: On the right... does that indescribable cone represent the spires of Leithanien?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: No. Imagine Sargon and its millennia of wind and sand, the lords ameer, the Padishah, the golden city... fantasizing the exotic is also a construct of internal order.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: The last gasp of imagination, once broad, now left with nothing but cliche.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Yes... Right, that makes sense.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I pulled all of that directly out of my behind.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Your artistic style has always been unique, from medium to expression.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: How many golf balls did it take? A thousand? Two thousand?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: That's not important. What's important is the last one. Would you do me a favor and put the finishing touch on it, by placing this one on top?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: What would happen?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It will be completed, and at that moment—
He sees shadows flash past the bottom gap of the office door.
The door is kicked open before he could react. The whole room trembles, causing the teetering sculpture before him to collapse, sending golf balls flying everywhere.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: ...'The Fall'?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Reynell and you, secretary over there. Hands on your heads and get down. No sudden moves.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Doesn't matter. You and your boss are going to come quietly, if you know what's good for you.
Something is approaching rapidly from above.
Must be a particularly big fowlbeast, the officer thought. He pays no heed to it and points his crossbow at Reynell, the half-collapsed golf ball sculpture standing between them.
Then, he hears a loud noise from the ceiling, right above what remains of the sculpture.
Then another.
This time, a large hole appears in the ceiling, along with the sound of broken planks.
Several dark shadows fall through the shrapnel-mixed dust onto the floor of Reynell's office, smashing what remained of the sculpture, sending golf balls flying in all directions.
The soldier was about to let out an expletive, but it died in his throat.
The shadows began to move.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Everybody alright?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Just a little scrape.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Doc?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I... I'm okay.
Iana gives Doc a hand and sees he is holding a golf ball, which left a round mark on his forehead.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I'm fine... other than a little knock from a golf ball.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Next question.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Anyone know what happened, other than that we somehow fell into a pile of golf balls?

steps.name: Bewildered Soldier
steps.text: Why didn't we go just in through the roof? We wouldn't have had to climb the stairs if we did that.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Shut up. Prepare to engage!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: A crossbow?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: ...Prepare to engage.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I guess you aren't exactly friends.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Did you bring a weapon, Miłosz?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: (Shrugs) Nope.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Well, in that case...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You'd better duke it out amongst yourselves to decide who gets to kidnap me. There's only one of me, after all.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: A drink, Miłosz?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Pass. I still have to protect you.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Kidnap?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: A furry kidnapping party? That's new.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Enough chit-chat! Drop your weapons and get away from Reynell, or we'll shoot!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Well, they're coming for us, kidnappers or not.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Find cover!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Iana, Doc, take the non-combatants and get out of here! Fuze and I will cover you!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: No Sankta halos, and they don't look like Blacksteel either...

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Do these idiots have a death wish? They just think guns look cool?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Move! Don't let them get away with Reynell!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: On your ten, Iana!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Hostile down!

steps.name: Alert Soldier
steps.text: Those guns aren't just for looks!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Stand your ground! We have backup!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Reserve squad! Quit fooling around and get out here!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I can't get to the non-combatants! There are too many of them. Iana and I are suppressed—

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Reloading!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I'm up!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Frag out!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Ineffective! Hostiles are blast resistant!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Roger. Fuze, smoke.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Smoke grenade out.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Smoke won't solve the real problem. Need a Cluster Charge? I still have plenty.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: That's one way, but Grzmot works better here.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Iana, Doc, get those non-combatants to cover! Fuze and I will cover!

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Firing!

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Stay back!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Don't resist! I'm taking you to cover!

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Why do we have to—

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: A sneak attack?!

steps.name: Alert Soldier
steps.text: Looks like you're more than just a secretary!

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You talk too much.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Get back, sir! You're in the line of fi—

steps.name: Alert Soldier
steps.text: Trying to fight real weapons with a wine bottle? Dumbass—

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Very immature.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: He's out cold. I'll carry him. You get that guy in white.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: They're trying to take Reynell away! Stop them!

steps.name: Slick Soldier
steps.text: We can't get close! Their guns fire too quickly!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Dammit, what the hell are you doing when they're not firing!

steps.name: Slick Soldier
steps.text: They keep finding dead zones! And their coordination—

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: There are only four of them! How many guys do we have?!

spans.text: There are only four of them! How many guys do

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: We're in cover! We can hold out for a while!

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Reloading!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: That guy's out! Get him!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Iana, smoke!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Smoke grenade out!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: *cough* *cough* Another smoke grenade? Is that the best you can—

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Flying out.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: ...Sticking it.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Here's a memento.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Get out of the way, Fuze!

steps.name: Slick Soldier
steps.text: The other two are trying to hide!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Surround them and—

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: They swarmed without any caution for possible explosives. No tactical awareness whatsoever.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Let's disarm them first. Tend to the wounded, Doc.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Clear.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Clear.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Clear.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: All clear. No casualties. That's good news.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Even though we were shooting to incapacitate rather than kill, these guys were still unusually tough. That one there survived a full shotgun blast at point-blank range.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Good news indeed.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: One more thing. Not sure what it means, but look at the animal ears... you can see blood vessels, if you look closely.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Is that part of Levi's research too?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: My compass isn't working. What about yours, Doc?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: If we're really near Magnethill No. 2 in the Southern Urals...
Doc looks behind him, where the wind is blowing the curtains open.
The squad walks out to the balcony and takes in the sight outside.
The setting sun shines down between towering skyscrapers, painting the waters red.
Tourists in swimsuits lie on the beach, enjoying a lazy holiday afternoon set to ice cream truck music.
The only man in the room who can still stand slowly walks towards them.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: If this is the Urals, then I'm George Clooney.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: It's clear we're no longer in the mission area.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Did we teleport?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Where to? The Maldives?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: It looks like a vacation spot alright... but I don't think it's the Maldives.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Maybe we can ask the unfortunate victims—Oh, speak of the devil.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Could you answer a few questions, sir? Who are you? What is this place? And who were those armed men?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I'm happy to explain a few things, out of 'gratitude' for the surprising ending that you created for my work.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Before formal introductions, however, I must correct one premise... I was never an unfortunate victim.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Not before, not now, not ever.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Can we get back on topic?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Very well. Welcome to the dark heart of Bolívar...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Welcome to Dossoles.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: My name is Reynell Kowalski.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Call me Ela, Mr. Reynell.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: But, given that we need to quickly grasp our situation, I think we can cut the introductions. I'll ask, and you'll answer. Alright?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Doesn't look like I have a choice.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Which country does Dossoles belong to?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Bolívar. In name, at least.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Bolívar... You mean Bolivia? I don't know a city called Dossoles in Bolivia. What about you, Iana?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Let's try another way. Which continent are we on? South America?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Continent? I'm not sure what you mean. If you mean the name of our 'landmass,' that's Terra, obviously?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Gówno......

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: (Kazimierzian) Oh? It's not every day I hear my mother tongue spoken.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Your mother tongue?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Nothing. Keep going.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I never thought I would be asking this, but...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Mr. Reynell, are we on Planet Earth?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Planet...? Earth...? I thought all I had to do was answer questions, but now I'm beginning to have a few of my own.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Iana, maybe you can do better with the questions...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Iana?
Iana does not answer.
Her eyes are wide, staring at the horizon in the opposite direction of the setting sun.
The others follow her gaze.
Two moons are rising slowly in the distance, one brighter than the other.

steps.name: Strangely-Dressed Durin
steps.text: Damn, only had time for one doodle before they found out.

steps.name: Strangely-Dressed Durin
steps.text: That was close... gave me a fright when all those people showed up.

steps.name: Galería Security
steps.text: Hold it right there, girl! You won't get away with vandalizing the Galería!

steps.name: Strangely-Dressed Durin
steps.text: Shoot. I'd better go.

steps.name: Strangely-Dressed Durin
steps.text: You got lucky today... Reynell.
